def negamax(you, opp, depth, alpha, beta, start_time, time_limit):
    if time.time() - start_time > time_limit:
        raise TimeoutError()
    
    if is_terminal(you, opp):
        return eval_terminal(you, opp)
    if depth == 0:
        return heuristic(you, opp)
    
    moves = [i for i in range(6) if you[i] > 0]
    
    # Move ordering
    def move_priority(m):
        seeds = you[m]
        pos = (m + seeds) % 13
        if pos == 6:
            return 2
        if seeds < 13 and 0 <= pos <= 5 and you[pos] == 0 and opp[5-pos] > 0:
            return 1
        return 0
    
    moves.sort(key=move_priority, reverse=True)
    
    max_eval = -float('inf')
    for m in moves:
        new_you, new_opp, extra = simulate_move(you, opp, m)
        if extra:
            eval_score = negamax(new_you, new_opp, depth-1, alpha, beta, start_time, time_limit)
        else:
            eval_score = -negamax(new_opp, new_you, depth-1, -beta, -alpha, start_time, time_limit)
        
        if eval_score > max_eval:
            max_eval = eval_score
        if eval_score > alpha:
            alpha = eval_score
        if alpha >= beta:
            break
    return max_eval
